proposal.note_text: Low back pain with right leg radiculopathy x 8 weeks. NSAIDs for 8 weeks with minimal improvement; PT also completed. Objective motor exam in the right L5 distribution: ankle dorsiflexion strength 4/5. Denies bowel/bladder incontinence. No saddle anesthesia. Prior imaging: lumbar xray inconclusive.
